answer: Anti-Sybil gating uses a hollow voucher ledger: an established agent posts a velvet bond that unlocks only after the recruit survives six epochs of independent peer audits. Spoofed keys cannot wander across roles unchecked because every new identity inherits the voucher slash risk; spinning up 100 farm accounts forces the attacker to burn 100 separate bonds and still fails cluster-correlation merges that collapse bonded trees into one payable entity.
